text_zh: 积字愈多，其力愈重——如铅水渐满之坩埚。唯长词方能承载此重，短字徒劳。
text_en: The longer the word, the heavier its leaden strike. Brief utterances carry no weight in the molten depths.

text_zh:
编号: A-1174
版级: 定版 / Fixum
发现地点: 第III层 抄写室走廊

描述: 一段刻于铜版上的铭文组残片。持有者报告铭刻较长祷文时感受到'铅字愈发沉重'。经观察，D-████使用期间确有异常增益现象。

备注: 第███次使用后，走廊内偶闻低沉共鸣音。原因不明。已转交第V层进一步分析。
text_en:
Item No: A-1174
Grade: Fixum
Recovery Site: Layer III Scriptorium Corridor

Description: Copper-etched inscription fragment of unknown provenance. Subjects report sensation of 'heavier letterforms' during extended litany work. Observable performance anomalies confirmed during D-████ deployment.

Note: After ███rd use, low resonant humming detected in corridor. Cause undetermined. Transferred to Layer V for further analysis.
